scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/session-ui && npm run build --workspace packages/cli
scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run check:static

scripts.release:check:candidate: npm run build && npm run check:static && npm test && npm run pack:check && npm run test:packed && npm run test:auto-update && npm run build:python && npm run check:python
scripts.pi:check: node scripts/apply-pi-content-policy.mjs --check && node scripts/apply-pi-path-utils.mjs --check && node scripts/apply-pi-terminal-clipboard.mjs --check && node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs check && node scripts/run-tests.mjs scripts/pi-content-policy.test.mjs scripts/pi-flow-control.test.mjs scripts/pi-flow-ingress.test.mjs scripts/pi-flow-ingress-dispositions.test.mjs scripts/pi-path-utils.test.mjs scripts/pi-provider-receipts.test.mjs scripts/pi-upstream.test.mjs scripts/code-previews.test.mjs

scripts.pi:qualify: npm run pi:check:online && npm run release:check:candidate && node scripts/check-pi-contract.mjs && node scripts/pi-upstream.mjs promote
scripts.release:check: npm run release:metadata && npm run release:check:candidate
